items.t: Says he is committed to fighting for clean and safe drinking water and against climate change.
items.q: Josh is also committed to fighting for clean and safe drinking water and against climate change and to protecting the rights of Wisconsinites.

items.t: Supports AB 67, legislation concerning prompt submission of sexual assault kits to state crime labs.
items.q: I strongly encourage the state assembly to pass AB 67, legislation that would help ensure that all sexual assault kits are promptly submitted to the state crime labs and that delays like this never happen again.

items.t: Says the Wisconsin Department of Justice under his leadership has worked to combat the opioid epidemic and the increasing use of meth in Wisconsin.

record.t: Announced a multistate coalition win in a lawsuit over federal National Electric Vehicle Infrastructure (NEVI) Formula Program funding.
record.q: Attorney General Josh Kaul and a multistate coalition have secured a win blocking the Trump administration’s attempt to illegally withhold billions of dollars in congressionally approved funding for the National Electric Vehicle Infrastructure (NEVI) Formula Program.

record.t: Was sworn in as Wisconsin's 45th Attorney General.
record.q: Josh Kaul was sworn in as Wisconsin’s 45th Attorney General on January 7, 2019.

record.t: Announced the prison sentencing of Joachim M McKnight for a March 1994 assault of a teenage victim.
record.q: Attorney General Josh Kaul announced today that Dane County Judge David Conway sentenced Joachim M McKnight to 3 years, 6 months in prison for the assault of a teenage victim that occurred in March 1994.
